meaning.en: Missing or invalid credential
meaning.es: Credencial ausente o inválida
meaning.zh: 凭证缺失或无效

meaning.en: Wrong email or password (login)
meaning.es: Email o contraseña incorrectos (login)
meaning.zh: 邮箱或密码错误（登录）

meaning.en: Refresh token invalid, expired, already used or revoked — send the user back to login
meaning.es: Refresh token inválido, expirado, ya usado o revocado — vuelve al login
meaning.zh: 刷新令牌无效、已过期、已被使用或已被吊销 —— 请引导用户重新登录

meaning.en: Endpoint requires an account credential
meaning.es: El endpoint exige credencial de cuenta
meaning.zh: 该端点需要账户级凭证

meaning.en: Endpoint requires an admin credential
meaning.es: El endpoint exige credencial de administrador
meaning.zh: 该端点需要管理员凭证

meaning.en: Credential level not allowed
meaning.es: Nivel de credencial no permitido
meaning.zh: 凭证级别不允许

meaning.en: The account is not active
meaning.es: La cuenta no está activa
meaning.zh: 账户处于非活跃状态

meaning.en: The service is not enabled for your account (check `GET /v1/services`)
meaning.es: El servicio no está habilitado para tu cuenta (consulta `GET /v1/services`)
meaning.zh: 该服务未对您的账户启用（查看 `GET /v1/services`）

meaning.en: Service suspended; contact the CBPay team
meaning.es: El servicio está suspendido; contacta al equipo de CBPay
meaning.zh: 服务已暂停；请联系 CBPay 团队

meaning.en: Feature only for company accounts
meaning.es: Función solo para cuentas empresa
meaning.zh: 仅企业账户可用的功能

meaning.en: Feature only for company accounts (e.g. third-party banking)
meaning.es: Función solo para cuentas empresa (ej. banking para terceros)
meaning.zh: 仅企业账户可用的功能（例如第三方银行服务）

meaning.en: The operation handles a private key (segregated wallet import/export) and requires a signed-in user session with 2FA — API keys are not allowed
meaning.es: La operación maneja llave privada (import/export de wallet segregada) y exige sesión de usuario con 2FA — las API keys no se permiten
meaning.zh: 该操作涉及私钥（独立钱包导入/导出），需要带 2FA 的已登录用户会话——不允许使用 API 密钥

meaning.en: The mirror user is disabled in the test environment; contact support
meaning.es: El usuario está bloqueado para iniciar sesión; contacta al administrador de tu organización
meaning.zh: 该用户已被禁止登录；请联系您组织的管理员

meaning.en: The passkey could not be verified; retry or sign in with another method
meaning.es: La verificación de la passkey falló; reintenta o entra con contraseña
meaning.zh: 通行密钥（passkey）验证失败；请重试或使用密码登录

meaning.en: Only the account owner can change the 2FA preferences
meaning.es: Solo el miembro owner de la cuenta puede ejecutar esa acción
meaning.zh: 只有账户的 owner 成员才能执行该操作

meaning.en: The action requires OTP: verify a challenge and retry with `X-OTP-Token`
meaning.es: La acción exige OTP: verifica un desafío y reintenta con `X-OTP-Token`
meaning.zh: 该操作需要 OTP：验证一个质询后携带 `X-OTP-Token` 重试

meaning.en: OTP token invalid, expired or already used
meaning.es: Token OTP inválido, expirado o ya usado
meaning.zh: OTP 令牌无效、已过期或已被使用

meaning.en: OTP challenges require a user session, not an API key
meaning.es: Los desafíos OTP requieren sesión de usuario, no API key
meaning.zh: OTP 质询需要用户会话，不能使用 API 密钥

meaning.en: Phone linked less than 24 h ago without verification and no alternative factor (authenticator app or verified email)
meaning.es: Teléfono enlazado hace menos de 24 h sin verificación y sin factor alternativo (app autenticadora o email verificado)
meaning.zh: 手机号绑定未满 24 小时且未经验证，且没有替代因素（身份验证器应用或已验证邮箱）

meaning.en: Verify your phone (OTP challenge) before enabling login 2FA over SMS/WhatsApp
meaning.es: Verifica tu teléfono (desafío OTP) antes de activar el 2FA de login por SMS/WhatsApp
meaning.zh: 通过 SMS/WhatsApp 启用登录 2FA 前需先验证手机号（OTP 挑战）

meaning.en: The code does not match
meaning.es: El código no coincide
meaning.zh: 验证码不匹配

meaning.en: The intermediate login token expired; log in again
meaning.es: El token intermedio del login expiró; vuelve a iniciar sesión
meaning.zh: 登录中间令牌已过期；请重新登录

meaning.en: Action or channel outside the catalog
meaning.es: Acción o canal fuera de catálogo
meaning.zh: 操作或渠道不在目录中

meaning.en: Action or channel outside the catalog
meaning.es: Acción o canal fuera de catálogo
meaning.zh: 操作或渠道不在目录中

meaning.en: The account has no phone (`PATCH /v1/me`)
meaning.es: La cuenta no tiene teléfono (`PATCH /v1/me`)
meaning.zh: 账户未绑定手机号（`PATCH /v1/me`）

meaning.en: Login requires OTP and the account has no phone; contact your operator
meaning.es: El login exige OTP y la cuenta no tiene teléfono; contacta a tu operador
meaning.zh: 登录需要 OTP 但账户没有手机号；请联系您的运营方

meaning.en: The challenge expired or was already used; create a new one
meaning.es: El desafío expiró o ya se usó; crea uno nuevo
meaning.zh: 质询已过期或已被使用；请创建一个新的

meaning.en: Send/verification limits reached; wait a few minutes
meaning.es: Límite de envíos o verificaciones; espera unos minutos
meaning.zh: 达到发送/验证次数限制；请等待几分钟

meaning.en: Two-factor authentication is not enabled for your organization; contact support
meaning.es: Tu organización no tiene habilitado el 2FA por acción; contacta a tu operador
meaning.zh: 您的组织未启用按操作的双因素认证；请联系您的运营方

meaning.en: Confirm requires starting enrollment first (`POST /v1/me/totp/enroll`)
meaning.es: No hay enrolamiento TOTP en curso; parte con `POST /v1/me/totp/enroll`
meaning.zh: 尚未开始 TOTP 注册；请先调用 `POST /v1/me/totp/enroll`

meaning.en: Verification service unavailable (the action stays blocked; OTP is never skipped)
meaning.es: Servicio de verificación no disponible (la acción queda bloqueada, nunca se salta el OTP)
meaning.zh: 验证服务不可用（操作保持锁定；OTP 绝不会被跳过）

meaning.en: Provider outside `google/apple/microsoft/facebook`
meaning.es: Proveedor fuera de `google/apple/microsoft/facebook`
meaning.zh: 提供方不在 `google/apple/microsoft/facebook` 范围内

meaning.en: Your organization has not enabled that provider
meaning.es: Tu organización no tiene ese proveedor habilitado
meaning.zh: 您的组织尚未启用该提供方

meaning.en: The provider credential is invalid, expired or from another app
meaning.es: La credencial del proveedor es inválida, expiró o es de otra app
meaning.zh: 提供方凭证无效、已过期或来自其他应用

meaning.en: An account with that email already exists; sign in and link the provider
meaning.es: Ya existe una cuenta con ese email; entra con tu método actual y vincula el proveedor
meaning.zh: 已存在使用该邮箱的账户；请先登录再绑定该提供方

meaning.en: That provider is already linked to another account
meaning.es: Ese proveedor ya está vinculado a otra cuenta
meaning.zh: 该提供方身份已绑定到其他账户

meaning.en: You cannot unlink your only sign-in method
meaning.es: No puedes desvincular tu único método de acceso
meaning.zh: 无法解绑您唯一的登录方式

meaning.en: The organization has not enabled global treasury visibility for its admin panel; ask a platform administrator to enable `global_treasury_read` in the organization settings
meaning.es: La organización no tiene habilitada la visibilidad de tesorería global en su panel admin; pide a un administrador de plataforma que habilite `global_treasury_read` en los settings de la organización
meaning.zh: 该组织尚未在其管理面板启用全局资金总览；请联系平台管理员在组织设置中启用 `global_treasury_read`

meaning.en: An organization setting was sent with the wrong type (e.g. `global_treasury_read` must be a boolean, not a string)
meaning.es: Un setting de la organización se envió con el tipo incorrecto (ej. `global_treasury_read` debe ser booleano, no un string)
meaning.zh: 组织设置的值类型有误（例如 `global_treasury_read` 必须是布尔值，而不是字符串）

meaning.en: Another admin is currently applying this adjustment; wait for that action to finish before trying again
meaning.es: Otro administrador está aplicando este ajuste; espera a que termine antes de intentarlo de nuevo
meaning.zh: 另一位管理员正在处理此 adjustment；请等待当前操作完成后再重试

meaning.es: Significado

meaning.en: Body is not valid JSON or has unknown fields
meaning.es: Body no es JSON válido o tiene campos desconocidos
meaning.zh: 请求体不是有效的 JSON 或包含未知字段

meaning.en: Organization settings are not a valid JSON object or could not be normalized; correct the settings payload and retry
meaning.es: Los settings de la organización no son un objeto JSON válido o no pudieron normalizarse; corrige el payload y reintenta
meaning.zh: 组织设置不是有效的 JSON 对象或无法规范化；请修正设置请求体后重试

meaning.en: `type` must be `person` or `company`
meaning.es: `type` debe ser `person` o `company`
meaning.zh: `type` 必须为 `person` 或 `company`

meaning.es: Campo requerido inválido

meaning.zh: 密码少于 8 个字符

meaning.en: Wrong organization slug (use `cbpay`)
meaning.es: Slug de organización incorrecto (usa `cbpay`)

meaning.zh: 缺少幂等键

meaning.en: The key uses a system-reserved prefix (`payin-convert:` or `checkout-swap:`, owned by auto-conversions) — pick another key
meaning.es: La clave usa un prefijo reservado del sistema (`payin-convert:` o `checkout-swap:`, propios de las auto-conversiones) — usa otra clave
meaning.zh: 幂等键使用了系统保留前缀（`payin-convert:` 或 `checkout-swap:`，属于自动转换）——请改用其他键

meaning.en: Missing payout beneficiary
meaning.es: Falta el beneficiario del payout
meaning.zh: 缺少付款收款人信息

meaning.en: Amount is not a valid positive decimal

meaning.zh: 金额不是有效的正十进制数

meaning.en: Missing withdrawal destination address
meaning.es: Falta dirección destino del retiro
meaning.zh: 缺少提现目标地址

meaning.en: Missing a required field (e.g. `enabled` on AML monitoring, `external_customer_id` on verifications)
meaning.es: Falta un campo requerido (ej. `enabled` en monitoreo AML, `external_customer_id` en verificaciones)
meaning.zh: 缺少必填字段（例如 AML 监控的 `enabled`、身份验证的 `external_customer_id`）

meaning.en: The payout QR is unreadable or unsupported (corrupt BR Code, bad checksum, or a dynamic PIX QR); the `message` explains the exact reason
meaning.es: QR de payout ilegible o no soportado (BR Code corrupto, checksum inválido o QR PIX dinámico); el `message` explica la razón exacta
meaning.zh: 出金二维码不可读或不受支持（BR Code 损坏、校验和无效或动态 PIX 二维码）；`message` 说明具体原因

meaning.en: That verification's liveness check already passed
meaning.es: La prueba de vida de esa verificación ya fue superada
meaning.zh: 该验证的活体检测已经通过

meaning.es: Suscripción de webhook inválida
meaning.zh: Webhook 订阅无效

meaning.es: Teléfono no normalizable a E.164 (contactos y `to_phone`)
meaning.zh: 手机号无法规范化为 E.164 格式（联系人和 `to_phone`）

meaning.en: The PDF report `lang` is not `en`, `es` or `zh` (AML report and verification report)
meaning.es: `lang` del informe PDF no es `en`, `es` ni `zh` (informe AML e informe de verificación)
meaning.zh: PDF 报告的 `lang` 不是 `en`、`es` 或 `zh`（AML 报告与验证报告）

meaning.en: `PATCH /v1/me` (or register) sent a non-empty locale outside `en` / `es` / `zh`. Empty string stores English. Distinct from `invalid_language` (PDF report `lang`) and from org-admin `invalid_value` on `default_locale`
meaning.es: `PATCH /v1/me` (o el registro) envió un locale no vacío fuera de `en` / `es` / `zh`. El string vacío guarda inglés. Distinto de `invalid_language` (`lang` de informe PDF) y del `invalid_value` de org-admin en `default_locale`
meaning.zh: `PATCH /v1/me`（或注册）发送了非空且不属于 `en` / `es` / `zh` 的 locale。空字符串会存为英语。不同于 `invalid_language`（PDF 报告的 `lang`），也不同于组织管理员在 `default_locale` 上的 `invalid_value`

meaning.en: The verification report `format` is not `pdf` or `json`
meaning.es: `format` del informe de verificación no es `pdf` ni `json`
meaning.zh: 验证报告的 `format` 不是 `pdf` 或 `json`

meaning.en: Contact import with more than 1,000 entries (paginate the upload)
meaning.es: Import de contactos con más de 1.000 entradas (pagina la subida)
meaning.zh: 联系人导入超过 1,000 条（请分批上传）

meaning.en: Alias must be 4–20 chars (a-z, 0-9, dot, underscore, hyphen), start/end alphanumeric, and not a reserved word
meaning.es: El alias debe tener 4–20 caracteres (a-z, 0-9, punto, guion bajo, guion), empezar/terminar alfanumérico y no ser palabra reservada
meaning.zh: 别名须为 4–20 个字符（a-z、0-9、点、下划线、连字符），首尾为字母或数字，且不能是保留词

meaning.en: The request body could not be read (binary uploads, webhooks)
meaning.es: No se pudo leer el body del request (subidas binarias, webhooks)
meaning.zh: 无法读取请求体（二进制上传、webhook）

meaning.en: The avatar body is empty or not a supported image (PNG/JPEG/WebP, max 512 KB)
meaning.es: El body del avatar está vacío o no es una imagen soportada (PNG/JPEG/WebP, máx 512 KB)
meaning.zh: 头像请求体为空或不是支持的图片格式（PNG/JPEG/WebP，最大 512 KB）

meaning.en: Subscription `interval` must be `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly` or `yearly`
meaning.es: El `interval` de la suscripción debe ser `daily`, `weekly`, `monthly` o `yearly`
meaning.zh: 订阅的 `interval` 必须是 `daily`、`weekly`、`monthly` 或 `yearly`

meaning.en: `GET /v1/resolve` needs `alias=` or `qr=`
meaning.es: `GET /v1/resolve` necesita `alias=` o `qr=`
meaning.zh: `GET /v1/resolve` 需要 `alias=` 或 `qr=` 参数

meaning.en: The new login email is the current one; use `POST /v1/me/email/verify` to verify it instead
meaning.es: El nuevo email de login es el actual; usa `POST /v1/me/email/verify` para verificarlo
meaning.zh: 新登录邮箱与当前邮箱相同；请改用 `POST /v1/me/email/verify` 进行验证

meaning.en: `settlement_hours` is only accepted on the `payin_card` fee service and must be a non-negative integer (`0` = immediate credit) — see fees
meaning.es: `settlement_hours` solo se acepta en el servicio de comisión `payin_card` y debe ser un entero no negativo (`0` = acreditación inmediata) — ver comisiones
meaning.zh: `settlement_hours` 仅支持 `payin_card` 费用服务，且必须是非负整数（`0` = 立即入账）— 参见费用

meaning.en: Malformed or missing country code — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. `GET /v1/aml/catalogs/cities?country=`); also a valid but unsupported country filter (e.g. a non-`US` `country` on the bank directory lookup)
meaning.es: Código de país mal formado o ausente — ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (ej. `GET /v1/aml/catalogs/cities?country=`); también un filtro de país válido pero no soportado (ej. un `country` distinto de `US` en el lookup del directorio bancario)
meaning.zh: 国家/地区代码格式错误或缺失——ISO 3166-1 alpha-2（例如 `GET /v1/aml/catalogs/cities?country=`）；也用于有效但不支持的国家/地区过滤条件（例如在银行目录查询中传入非 `US` 的 `country`）

meaning.en: Not enough available balance — on outbound banking transfers the check includes the rail fee (`balance >= amount + fee`); the operation is not created when it does not hold
meaning.es: Saldo disponible insuficiente — en transferencias banking salientes el chequeo incluye la comisión del riel (`saldo >= monto + comisión`); la operación no se crea si no se cumple
meaning.zh: 可用余额不足——对于银行转出，校验包含通道费用（`余额 ≥ 金额 + 费用`）；不满足时不会创建该操作

meaning.en: Resource does not exist (or belongs to another account)
meaning.es: Recurso inexistente (o de otra cuenta)
meaning.zh: 资源不存在（或属于其他账户）

meaning.en: Unknown ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (cities catalog)
meaning.es: Código de país ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 desconocido (catálogo de ciudades)
meaning.zh: 未知的 ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 国家/地区代码（城市目录）

meaning.en: The routing number or SWIFT/BIC is not in the embedded bank directory — keep the payout/counterparty form manual
meaning.es: El routing number o SWIFT/BIC no está en el directorio bancario embebido — el formulario de payout/contraparte sigue manual
meaning.zh: 该 routing number 或 SWIFT/BIC 不在嵌入式银行目录中——payout/交易对手表单保持手动填写

meaning.en: Unknown postal code, or a country without a dataset (postal code lookup) — keep the address fields manual
meaning.es: Código postal desconocido, o un país sin dataset (lookup por código postal) — los campos de dirección siguen manuales
meaning.zh: 未知邮政编码，或该国家/地区没有数据集（邮政编码查询）——地址字段保持手动填写

meaning.en: Transfer destination does not exist
meaning.es: Destino de transferencia inexistente
meaning.zh: 转账目标不存在

meaning.en: The account has no submitted verification yet (`GET /v1/me/verification/report` before onboarding)
meaning.es: La cuenta aún no tiene ninguna verificación enviada (`GET /v1/me/verification/report` antes del onboarding)
meaning.zh: 账户尚未提交任何验证（在完成入驻前调用 `GET /v1/me/verification/report`）

meaning.en: The resource already exists
meaning.es: El recurso ya existe
meaning.zh: 资源已存在

meaning.en: Your account has not approved its identity verification yet (person=KYC, company=KYB); until then you can only fund — request your link at `POST /v1/me/verification/link`
meaning.es: Tu cuenta aún no aprobó su verificación de identidad (persona=KYC, empresa=KYB); hasta entonces solo puedes fondear — pide tu link en `POST /v1/me/verification/link`
meaning.zh: 您的账户尚未通过身份验证（个人=KYC，企业=KYB）；在此之前只能入金——通过 `POST /v1/me/verification/link` 申请您的验证链接

meaning.en: The referenced verification is not approved yet
meaning.es: La verificación referenciada aún no está aprobada
meaning.zh: 所引用的验证尚未通过

meaning.en: The verification kind does not match the product (KYC ⇒ person/INDIVIDUAL, KYB ⇒ company/COMPANY)
meaning.es: El kind de la verificación no calza con el producto (KYC ⇒ persona/INDIVIDUAL, KYB ⇒ empresa/COMPANY)
meaning.zh: 验证类型与产品不匹配（KYC ⇒ person/INDIVIDUAL，KYB ⇒ company/COMPANY）

meaning.en: You referenced an own-onboarding verification where a third-party one is required
meaning.es: Referenciaste una verificación de onboarding propio donde se exige la de un tercero
meaning.zh: 在需要第三方验证的场景引用了自身入驻的验证

meaning.en: Third-party verification (KYC/KYB links/submissions) is for company accounts only
meaning.es: La verificación de terceros (links/submissions KYC-KYB) es solo para cuentas empresa
meaning.zh: 第三方验证（KYC/KYB 链接/提交）仅限企业账户

meaning.en: Onboarding link requested with an already-verified account
meaning.es: Pediste link de onboarding con la cuenta ya verificada
meaning.zh: 使用已通过验证的账户请求了入驻链接

meaning.en: With the verification approved, `display_name`, `tax_id` and `country` come from the verified identity and cannot be changed via `PATCH /v1/me`; contact support
meaning.es: Con la verificación aprobada, `display_name`, `tax_id` y `country` vienen de la identidad verificada y no se cambian por `PATCH /v1/me`; contacta al soporte
meaning.zh: 验证获批后，`display_name`、`tax_id` 和 `country` 来自已验证的身份，无法通过 `PATCH /v1/me` 修改；请联系支持

meaning.en: AML rescreen/monitoring without a prior screening
meaning.es: Rescreen/monitoreo AML sin un screening previo
meaning.zh: 在没有先行筛查的情况下发起 AML 重新筛查/监控

meaning.en: Banking operation without a banking profile (`POST /v1/banking/customer` first)
meaning.es: Operación banking sin perfil bancario creado (`POST /v1/banking/customer` primero)
meaning.zh: 在没有银行账户资料的情况下发起银行操作（请先 `POST /v1/banking/customer`）

meaning.en: The account already has a banking profile (one per account)
meaning.es: La cuenta ya tiene perfil bancario (es uno por cuenta)
meaning.zh: 该账户已有银行账户资料（每个账户仅限一个）

meaning.en: The same banking profile claim is still pending or the payload changed — keep the same request data and wait for reconciliation
meaning.es: El claim del mismo perfil banking sigue pendiente o cambió el payload — conserva la misma solicitud y espera la reconciliación
meaning.zh: 同一 banking profile claim 仍为 pending 或 payload 已变化——保持相同请求并等待核对

meaning.en: The customer creation outcome is ambiguous — operations must reconcile the durable claim before retrying with a new key
meaning.es: El resultado del alta es ambiguo — operaciones debe reconciliar el claim durable antes de reintentar con una clave nueva
meaning.zh: customer 创建结果不明确——运营人员必须先核对持久 claim，再使用新密钥重试

meaning.en: No FX rate for that currency
meaning.es: Sin tasa FX para esa moneda
meaning.zh: 该货币没有汇率

meaning.en: The processor rejected the operation — when the message reports an **incomplete billing address** (or a missing state/region), the stored card has no usable billing address on file: have the payer save it again with `save_card: true`
meaning.es: El procesador rechazó la operación — cuando el mensaje reporta una **dirección de facturación incompleta** (o estado/región faltante), la tarjeta guardada no tiene una dirección utilizable en archivo: pide al pagador guardarla de nuevo con `save_card: true`
meaning.zh: 处理方拒绝了该操作 —— 当消息报告**账单地址不完整**（或缺少州/省）时，已保存的卡没有可用的账单地址：请让付款人通过 `save_card: true` 重新保存

meaning.en: The destination account cannot receive
meaning.es: La cuenta destino no puede recibir
meaning.zh: 目标账户无法接收

meaning.en: More than one account shares the `to_phone` number (use `to_account_id` or `to_email`)
meaning.es: Más de una cuenta comparte el teléfono de `to_phone` (usa `to_account_id` o `to_email`)
meaning.zh: 多个账户共用该 `to_phone` 号码（请使用 `to_account_id` 或 `to_email`）

meaning.en: The contact has no linked CBPay account to transfer to
meaning.es: El contacto no tiene cuenta CBPay asociada para transferirle
meaning.zh: 该联系人没有可转账的已关联 CBPay 账户

meaning.en: The contact has no saved destination for that corridor/chain
meaning.es: El contacto no tiene destino guardado para ese corredor/chain
meaning.zh: 该联系人在该通道/链上没有已保存的目标

meaning.en: The account already holds its wallet for that network+asset pair (deposit: every account; segregated: persons)
meaning.es: La cuenta ya tiene su wallet de esa combinación red+activo (depósito: todas las cuentas; segregadas: personas)
meaning.zh: 该账户在此网络+资产组合下已持有对应钱包（充值钱包：所有账户；隔离钱包：个人账户）

meaning.en: The segregated wallet has no native gas (TRX/ETH) for the network fee; fund the address and retry
meaning.es: La wallet segregada no tiene gas nativo (TRX/ETH) para el fee de red; fondea la dirección y reintenta
meaning.zh: 独立钱包没有支付网络费所需的原生 gas（TRX/ETH）；请为该地址充值后重试

meaning.en: A person account tried to create a second card of the same type
meaning.es: Una cuenta persona intentó crear una segunda tarjeta del mismo tipo
meaning.zh: 个人账户试图创建第二张同类型卡片

meaning.en: The card is already cancelled and cannot be updated
meaning.es: La tarjeta ya está cancelada y no se puede modificar
meaning.zh: 卡片已注销，无法更新

meaning.en: Only cards in `pending_activation` can be activated
meaning.es: Solo tarjetas en `pending_activation` se pueden activar
meaning.zh: 只有处于 `pending_activation` 状态的卡片才能激活

meaning.en: The designated cardholder requires identity documents
meaning.es: El titular designado requiere documentos de identidad
meaning.zh: 指定持卡人需要提交身份证明文件

meaning.en: `occupation` is not a catalog code (`GET /v1/cards/catalog/occupations`)
meaning.es: `occupation` no es un código del catálogo (`GET /v1/cards/catalog/occupations`)
meaning.zh: `occupation` 不是目录中的代码（`GET /v1/cards/catalog/occupations`）

meaning.en: `kind_of_business` is not a catalog code (`GET /v1/cards/catalog/business-activities`)
meaning.es: `kind_of_business` no es un código del catálogo (`GET /v1/cards/catalog/business-activities`)
meaning.zh: `kind_of_business` 不是目录中的代码（`GET /v1/cards/catalog/business-activities`）

meaning.en: `settlement_asset` is not USDT, USDC, BTC or GOLD
meaning.es: `settlement_asset` no es USDT, USDC, BTC ni GOLD
meaning.zh: `settlement_asset` 不是 USDT、USDC、BTC 或 GOLD

meaning.en: Your organization disabled that asset as settlement source
meaning.es: Tu organización tiene deshabilitado ese asset como origen de settlement
meaning.zh: 您的组织已禁用该资产作为结算来源

meaning.en: The operation exceeds the per-operation limit for volatile assets (BTC/GOLD); use USDT/USDC or split the operation
meaning.es: La operación supera el límite por operación de los assets volátiles (BTC/GOLD); usa USDT/USDC o divide la operación
meaning.zh: 该操作超出波动性资产（BTC/GOLD）的单笔操作限额；请使用 USDT/USDC 或拆分操作

meaning.en: The account exceeded its 24h volume for volatile assets (BTC/GOLD); use USDT/USDC or retry later
meaning.es: La cuenta superó su volumen de 24 h en assets volátiles (BTC/GOLD); usa USDT/USDC o reintenta más tarde
meaning.zh: 该账户已超出波动性资产（BTC/GOLD）的 24 小时交易量限额；请使用 USDT/USDC 或稍后重试

meaning.en: Swap with the same source and destination currency
meaning.es: Swap con la misma moneda de origen y destino
meaning.zh: 兑换（swap）的源货币与目标货币相同

meaning.en: The swap amount does not reach the destination currency's minimum unit
meaning.es: El monto del swap no alcanza la unidad mínima de la moneda destino
meaning.zh: 兑换金额不足目标货币的最小单位

meaning.en: One of the swap currencies is disabled for your organization
meaning.es: Una de las monedas del swap está deshabilitada para tu organización
meaning.zh: 兑换涉及的某一货币已被您的组织禁用

meaning.en: The universal checkout link was already paid through another method
meaning.es: El link de cobro universal ya se pagó por otro método
meaning.zh: 通用收款链接已通过其他方式支付

meaning.en: The universal checkout link expired unpaid
meaning.es: El link de cobro universal venció sin pago
meaning.zh: 通用收款链接到期未支付

meaning.en: The method chosen on the checkout link is not available for that link or country
meaning.es: El método elegido en el link de cobro no está disponible para ese link o país
meaning.zh: 收款链接上所选方式对该链接或国家不可用

meaning.en: Fiat materialization on the checkout link is missing `?country=XX`
meaning.es: Materialización fiat del link de cobro sin `?country=XX`
meaning.zh: 收款链接的法币物化缺少 `?country=XX`

meaning.en: The country offers the checkout link method in several currencies; `?currency=YYY` is missing
meaning.es: El país ofrece el método del link de cobro en varias monedas; falta `?currency=YYY`
meaning.zh: 该国家以多种币种提供收款链接的方式；缺少 `?currency=YYY`

meaning.en: That country has no payment methods available on the checkout link
meaning.es: Ese país no tiene métodos de pago disponibles en el link de cobro
meaning.zh: 该国家在收款链接上没有可用的支付方式

meaning.en: The rail rejected the OTP delivery for the link's pull collection
meaning.es: El rail rechazó el envío de la clave OTP del cobro pull del link
meaning.zh: 通道拒绝发送链接拉取式收款的 OTP

meaning.en: The rail rejected the link's pull charge (invalid OTP or wrong data); the link stays pending
meaning.es: El rail rechazó el cobro pull del link (OTP inválida o datos incorrectos); el link sigue pendiente
meaning.zh: 通道拒绝了链接的拉取式扣款（OTP 无效或数据错误）；链接保持待支付

meaning.en: The CBPay transfer does not cover the checkout link's current due; the message carries the updated amount
meaning.es: La transferencia CBPay no cubre el monto vigente del link de cobro; el mensaje trae el monto actualizado
meaning.zh: CBPay 转账不足以覆盖收款链接的当前应付额；错误消息附带最新金额

meaning.en: The saved card is revoked; it no longer accepts charges
meaning.es: La tarjeta guardada está revocada; no acepta más cobros
meaning.zh: 已保存的卡片已被撤销；不再接受扣款

meaning.en: The QR Crypto POS merchant is disabled; re-enable it before charging
meaning.es: El merchant QR Crypto POS está deshabilitado; reactívalo antes de generar cobros
meaning.zh: QR Crypto POS 商户已停用；先重新启用再生成收款

meaning.en: The QR Crypto POS charge has not received any on-chain payment: there is nothing to refund
meaning.es: El cobro QR Crypto POS no ha recibido ningún pago on-chain: no hay nada que devolver
meaning.zh: QR Crypto POS 收款未收到任何链上支付：无可退款

meaning.en: The refund exceeds what the QR Crypto POS charge received minus prior refunds
meaning.es: La devolución supera lo recibido menos lo ya devuelto del cobro QR Crypto POS
meaning.zh: 退款超过 QR Crypto POS 收款已收金额减去已退金额

meaning.en: Accounts hold one deposit account per corridor (created automatically with the account); it cannot be changed or deleted
meaning.es: Las cuentas tienen una cuenta de depósito por corredor (creada automáticamente con la cuenta); no se puede cambiar ni eliminar
meaning.zh: 每个账户每条走廊只有一个入金账户（随账户自动创建）；不可更改或删除

meaning.en: The processor rejected the segregated wallet key export
meaning.es: El procesador rechazó el export de la llave de la wallet segregada
meaning.zh: 处理方拒绝了该独立钱包的私钥导出

meaning.en: The saved card belongs to a different country/currency corridor than the charge
meaning.es: La tarjeta guardada pertenece a otro corredor país/moneda distinto del cobro
meaning.zh: 该已保存卡片属于与本次收款不同的国家/货币走廊

meaning.en: The subscription is not in a state that allows that action (e.g. pausing a canceled plan)
meaning.es: La suscripción no está en un estado que permita esa acción (ej. pausar un plan cancelado)
meaning.zh: 该订阅当前状态不允许该操作（例如暂停已取消的计划）

meaning.en: The login has no real email address; set one with `POST /v1/me/email/change`
meaning.es: El login no tiene un email real; configura uno con `POST /v1/me/email/change`
meaning.zh: 该登录没有真实邮箱；请通过 `POST /v1/me/email/change` 设置

meaning.en: The payin is not credited or has no processor credential; it cannot be refunded
meaning.es: El cobro no está acreditado o no tiene credencial del procesador; no se puede devolver
meaning.zh: 该收款未入账或没有处理机构凭证，无法退款

meaning.en: That rail does not support refunds (QR, announced transfer, dedicated account, collect). POS charges are refunded through the crypto rail
meaning.es: Ese rail no admite devoluciones (QR, transferencia anunciada, cuenta dedicada, collect). Los cobros POS se devuelven por el riel crypto
meaning.zh: 该通道不支持退款（QR、报备转账、专属账户、代扣）。POS 收款通过加密通道退款

meaning.en: The refund exceeds what is left to refund on the payin; your balance was not touched
meaning.es: La devolución supera lo que queda por devolver del cobro; tu saldo no se tocó
meaning.zh: 退款超过该收款的剩余可退金额；余额未变动

meaning.en: The payin's balance is still scheduled for settlement and cannot be refunded until it is released (at `settle_at` or by an org-admin release)
meaning.es: El saldo del cobro sigue programado para settlement y no se puede devolver hasta liberarse (a `settle_at` o por liberación del admin de la organización)
meaning.zh: 该收款的余额仍在结算排期中，释放（到达 `settle_at` 或由组织管理员释放）前无法退款

meaning.en: The operation was held by the platform's compliance controls. It is not a request error: contact support with the timestamp — by policy the exact reason is not disclosed
meaning.es: La operación fue retenida por los controles de cumplimiento de la plataforma. No es un error de tu request: contacta a soporte con el timestamp — por política no se informa la razón exacta
meaning.zh: 该操作已被平台的合规控制拦截。这不是请求错误：请携带时间戳联系支持团队 — 根据政策，不会披露具体原因

meaning.en: The service or the operation is not available for the origin or counterparty jurisdiction
meaning.es: El servicio o la operación no están disponibles para la jurisdicción de origen o de la contraparte
meaning.zh: 该服务或操作不适用于发起方或交易对手所在的司法辖区

meaning.en: The compliance check could not be evaluated; the operation did NOT go out — retry with the **same** idempotency key
meaning.es: La verificación de cumplimiento no se pudo evaluar; la operación NO salió — reintenta con la **misma** clave de idempotencia
meaning.zh: 合规检查暂时无法执行；操作**未**发出 — 请使用**相同的**幂等键重试

meaning.en: On-chain withdrawal above the Travel Rule threshold without beneficiary data — add `travel_address` or `wallet_type: "self_hosted"` + `beneficiary_name` (crypto guide)
meaning.es: Retiro on-chain sobre el umbral Travel Rule sin datos del beneficiario — agrega `travel_address` o `wallet_type: "self_hosted"` + `beneficiary_name` (guía crypto)
meaning.zh: 超过 Travel Rule 阈值的链上提现缺少受益人数据 — 补充 `travel_address` 或 `wallet_type: "self_hosted"` + `beneficiary_name`（加密货币指南）

meaning.en: `beneficiary_name` is missing on a withdrawal subject to the Travel Rule
meaning.es: Falta `beneficiary_name` en un retiro sujeto a Travel Rule
meaning.zh: 适用 Travel Rule 的提现缺少 `beneficiary_name`

meaning.en: Your `to_address` does not match the payment address approved by the receiving institution — omit it or use the one from the exchange
meaning.es: Tu `to_address` no coincide con la dirección de pago aprobada por la institución receptora — omítela o usa la del intercambio
meaning.zh: 您的 `to_address` 与收款机构批准的付款地址不一致 — 省略它或使用交换返回的地址

meaning.en: The receiving institution rejected the transfer; verify the beneficiary data
meaning.es: La institución receptora rechazó la transferencia; verifica los datos del beneficiario
meaning.zh: 收款机构拒绝了该转账；请核对受益人数据

meaning.en: The receiving institution has not resolved the exchange yet; retry with the **same** idempotency key
meaning.es: La institución receptora aún no resuelve el intercambio; reintenta con la **misma** clave de idempotencia
meaning.zh: 收款机构尚未处理该交换；请使用**相同的**幂等键重试

meaning.en: The receiving institution approved without providing a payment address; contact support
meaning.es: La institución receptora aprobó sin entregar dirección de pago; contacta a soporte
meaning.zh: 收款机构批准时未提供付款地址；请联系支持团队

meaning.en: Travel Rule exchange temporarily unavailable; retry with the **same** idempotency key
meaning.es: Intercambio Travel Rule temporalmente no disponible; reintenta con la **misma** clave de idempotencia
meaning.zh: Travel Rule 数据交换暂时不可用；请使用**相同的**幂等键重试

meaning.en: Missing `purpose` when creating a report — data protection law requires declaring it (`credit_evaluation`, `tenant_screening`, `hiring`, `supplier_onboarding` or `other`)
meaning.es: Falta `purpose` al crear un informe — la ley de protección de datos exige declararlo (`credit_evaluation`, `tenant_screening`, `hiring`, `supplier_onboarding` u `other`)
meaning.zh: 创建报告时缺少 `purpose` — 数据保护法要求声明用途(`credit_evaluation`、`tenant_screening`、`hiring`、`supplier_onboarding` 或 `other`)

meaning.en: The `purpose` is not one of the allowed values (`credit_evaluation`, `tenant_screening`, `hiring`, `supplier_onboarding`, `other`) — fix the value. `self_access` is rejected here: your own report only goes through `POST /v1/qscore/my-report`
meaning.es: El `purpose` no es uno de los valores permitidos (`credit_evaluation`, `tenant_screening`, `hiring`, `supplier_onboarding`, `other`) — corrige el valor. `self_access` se rechaza aquí: tu propio informe solo va por `POST /v1/qscore/my-report`
meaning.zh: `purpose` 不是允许的值之一(`credit_evaluation`、`tenant_screening`、`hiring`、`supplier_onboarding`、`other`)— 请修正该值。`self_access` 在此被拒绝:您自己的报告只能通过 `POST /v1/qscore/my-report` 获取

meaning.en: The `doc_id` is not valid for the given `country` (e.g. bad RUT check digit in Chile) — fix the document format
meaning.es: El `doc_id` no es válido para el `country` indicado (ej. dígito verificador de RUT incorrecto en Chile) — corrige el formato del documento
meaning.zh: `doc_id` 在给定的 `country` 无效(例如智利 RUT 校验位错误)— 修正证件格式

meaning.en: `subject_type` is not `person`/`company` and could not be inferred from the document — send it explicitly
meaning.es: `subject_type` no es `person`/`company` y no se pudo inferir del documento — envíalo explícito
meaning.zh: `subject_type` 不是 `person`/`company` 且无法从证件推断 — 请显式发送

meaning.en: The verified `tax_id` of the account is not valid for its country (self report) — contact support to fix your verified data
meaning.es: El `tax_id` verificado de la cuenta no es válido para su país (informe self) — contacta a soporte para corregir tus datos verificados
meaning.zh: 账户已验证的 `tax_id` 在其国家/地区无效(自助报告)— 请联系客服修正您的已验证信息

meaning.en: Pulling your own report requires an approved KYC/KYB — complete the identity verification first
meaning.es: Generar tu propio informe exige un KYC/KYB aprobado — completa primero la verificación de identidad
meaning.zh: 生成您自己的报告需要已批准的 KYC/KYB — 请先完成身份验证

meaning.en: Enabling monitoring requires a purchased report for that subject — buy one first (guide); for privacy, a subject that does not exist gets this same response
meaning.es: Activar el monitoreo exige un informe comprado de ese sujeto — compra uno primero (guía); por privacidad, un sujeto inexistente recibe esta misma respuesta
meaning.zh: 启用监控需要先购买该主体的报告 — 请先购买(指南);出于隐私保护,主体不存在时也会返回相同的响应

meaning.en: The subject has no computed score yet — buy a report first
meaning.es: El sujeto aún no tiene un score calculado — compra un informe primero
meaning.zh: 该主体尚无已计算的评分 — 请先购买报告

meaning.en: The report PDF is not available yet — poll the detail until `status=ready` (the `risk_report_ready` webhook tells you)
meaning.es: El PDF del informe aún no está disponible — consulta el detalle hasta `status=ready` (el webhook `risk_report_ready` te avisa)
meaning.zh: 报告 PDF 尚不可用 — 轮询详情直到 `status=ready`(`risk_report_ready` webhook 会通知你)

meaning.en: The verified account has no `tax_id` on file, so the self report cannot resolve its subject — complete your verified data first
meaning.es: La cuenta verificada no tiene `tax_id` registrado, así que el informe self no puede resolver su sujeto — completa primero tus datos verificados
meaning.zh: 已验证账户没有 `tax_id` 记录,自助报告无法解析其主体 — 请先完善您的已验证信息

meaning.en: The account `tax_id` does not match the verified identity document (self report) — contact support; your verified data must be consistent
meaning.es: El `tax_id` de la cuenta no calza con el documento de identidad verificado (informe self) — contacta a soporte; tus datos verificados deben ser consistentes
meaning.zh: 账户的 `tax_id` 与已验证的身份文件不符(自助报告)— 请联系支持;您的已验证数据必须一致

meaning.en: This Qscore fraud/identity flow is not available for the selected country — use a supported country or contact support
meaning.es: Este flujo de fraude/identidad de Qscore no está disponible para el país seleccionado — usa un país compatible o contacta a soporte
meaning.zh: 所选国家暂不支持 Qscore 欺诈/身份流程；请选择支持的国家或联系支持

meaning.en: The fraud report is still being finalized — poll the report with the same credentials and retry the PDF after it reaches `ready`
meaning.es: El informe de fraude todavía se está finalizando — consulta el informe con las mismas credenciales y reintenta el PDF cuando llegue a `ready`
meaning.zh: 欺诈报告仍在完成中；使用相同凭证轮询报告，状态变为 `ready` 后再重试 PDF

meaning.en: Every row of the batch was rejected (`invalid_doc_id` / `duplicate_in_batch`) and no batch was created — validate the file locally (each `doc_id` must pass the country check digit and be unique) and resubmit with a **new** idempotency key
meaning.es: Todas las filas del lote fueron rechazadas (`invalid_doc_id` / `duplicate_in_batch`) y no se creó ningún lote — valida el archivo localmente (cada `doc_id` debe pasar el dígito verificador del país y ser único) y reenvía con una clave de idempotencia **nueva**
meaning.zh: 批次中的所有行均被拒绝(`invalid_doc_id` / `duplicate_in_batch`),且未创建任何批次 — 请在本地校验文件(每个 `doc_id` 必须通过该国校验位且保持唯一),然后使用**新的**幂等键重新提交

meaning.en: A batch accepts at most 5,000 subjects — split the portfolio into multiple batches, each with its own idempotency key
meaning.es: Un lote acepta a lo más 5.000 sujetos — parte la cartera en varios lotes, cada uno con su propia clave de idempotencia
meaning.zh: 单个批次最多接受 5,000 个主体 — 请将投资组合拆分为多个批次,每个批次使用各自的幂等键

meaning.en: The consent link was already decided (`granted`, `revoked` or `expired`) and cannot transition again — create a new link if you need a fresh authorization
meaning.es: El link de consentimiento ya fue decidido (`granted`, `revoked` o `expired`) y no puede transicionar de nuevo — crea un link nuevo si necesitas otra autorización
meaning.zh: 授权链接已被处理(`granted`、`revoked` 或 `expired`),无法再次变更状态 — 如需重新授权,请创建新的链接

meaning.en: The banking connection behind the consent is not `active` (the widget session expired or the link was revoked) — the holder must reconnect from the same consent link
meaning.es: La conexión bancaria detrás del consentimiento no está `active` (la sesión del widget expiró o el vínculo se revocó) — el titular debe reconectar desde el mismo link
meaning.zh: 授权背后的银行连接未处于 `active` 状态(widget 会话已过期或链接已被撤销)— 持有人需通过同一授权链接重新连接

meaning.en: The document verified by the bank does not match the subject `doc_id` — an account owned by a different document can never grant the consent; check that you created the link for the right document
meaning.es: El documento verificado por el banco no calza con el `doc_id` del sujeto — una cuenta de OTRO documento jamás otorga el consentimiento; verifica que creaste el link para el documento correcto
meaning.zh: 银行验证的证件与主体的 `doc_id` 不一致 — 属于其他证件的账户永远无法授予授权;请确认为正确的证件创建了链接

meaning.en: The public Qscore seal is only available for **company** accounts — person accounts have no seal (guide)
meaning.es: El sello público Qscore es solo para cuentas **empresa** — las cuentas persona no tienen sello (guía)
meaning.zh: Qscore 公开印章仅适用于**企业**账户 — 个人账户没有印章(指南)

meaning.en: The account's Qscore does not currently qualify for a public seal (band A or B with an evaluation no older than 90 days) — buy a fresh report (guide) and, if the band stays below B, the seal stays unavailable until the score improves
meaning.es: El Qscore de la cuenta no califica ahora para un sello público (banda A o B con una evaluación de no más de 90 días) — compra un informe fresco (guía) y, si la banda sigue bajo B, el sello no estará disponible hasta que el score mejore
meaning.zh: 该账户的 Qscore 当前不符合公开印章资格(等级 A 或 B,且评估不超过 90 天)— 请先购买最新报告(指南);若等级仍低于 B,印章在分数提升前不可用

meaning.en: The account has no active seal to revoke — activate one first with `POST /v1/qscore/my-seal`; a revoked seal stays revoked permanently (create a new one instead)
meaning.es: La cuenta no tiene un sello activo que revocar — activa uno primero con `POST /v1/qscore/my-seal`; un sello revocado queda revocado permanentemente (crea uno nuevo)
meaning.zh: 该账户没有可撤销的有效印章 — 请先通过 `POST /v1/qscore/my-seal` 激活;已撤销的印章将永久失效(可创建新印章)

meaning.en: Invalid `from`/`to` dates — `YYYY-MM-DD` format (organization timezone)
meaning.es: Fechas `from`/`to` inválidas — formato `YYYY-MM-DD` (zona horaria de tu organización)
meaning.zh: `from`/`to` 日期无效——格式为 `YYYY-MM-DD`（组织时区）

meaning.en: Missing filename in the `name` query param (max 200 chars, no path separators)
meaning.es: Falta el nombre del archivo en el query param `name` (máx. 200 caracteres, sin separadores de ruta)
meaning.zh: 缺少查询参数 `name` 中的文件名（最多 200 个字符，不含路径分隔符）

meaning.en: The file body arrived empty
meaning.es: El body del archivo llegó vacío
meaning.zh: 文件请求体为空

meaning.en: The review is not waiting for information (it already moved back to `in_review` or has a final decision) — check its current state
meaning.es: La revisión no está esperando información (ya volvió a `in_review` o tiene decisión final) — consulta su estado actual
meaning.zh: 该审核不在等待信息（已回到 `in_review` 或已有最终决定）——请查询其当前状态

meaning.en: The file exceeds the 50 MB limit — compress it or split it
meaning.es: El archivo supera el límite de 50 MB — comprímelo o divídelo
meaning.zh: 文件超过 50 MB 上限——请压缩或拆分

meaning.en: Unsupported type — use PDF, PNG, JPEG, WEBP, TXT, CSV, DOC(X) or XLS(X) with the correct `Content-Type` header
meaning.es: Tipo no permitido — usa PDF, PNG, JPEG, WEBP, TXT, CSV, DOC(X) o XLS(X) con el header `Content-Type` correcto
meaning.zh: 不支持的类型——请使用 PDF、PNG、JPEG、WEBP、TXT、CSV、DOC(X) 或 XLS(X)，并携带正确的 `Content-Type` 请求头

meaning.en: The review already has 20 files
meaning.es: La revisión ya tiene 20 archivos
meaning.zh: 该审核已有 20 个文件

meaning.en: The policy could not be evaluated or the review could not be persisted — retry with the **same** idempotency key
meaning.es: No se pudo evaluar la política o persistir la revisión — reintenta con la **misma** clave de idempotencia
meaning.zh: 无法评估策略或无法保存审核——请使用**相同的**幂等键重试

meaning.en: File storage is unavailable — retry in a few seconds
meaning.es: El almacenamiento de archivos no está disponible — reintenta en unos segundos
meaning.zh: 文件存储暂不可用——请稍后重试

meaning.en: Concurrent stream limit reached (per account or per organization) — close one before opening another
meaning.es: Se alcanzó el límite de streams simultáneos (por cuenta o por organización) — cierra uno antes de abrir otro
meaning.zh: 已达到并发流上限（按账户或按组织）— 请先关闭一个再打开新的

meaning.en: Too many stream openings from this IP (600 per hour) — the quota counts *attempts*, not live connections: stop the reconnect loop and back off
meaning.es: Demasiadas aperturas de stream desde esta IP (600 por hora) — la cuota cuenta *intentos*, no conexiones vivas: corta el bucle de reconexión y aplica backoff
meaning.zh: 该 IP 打开事件流过于频繁（每小时 600 次）— 该配额统计*尝试次数*而非活动连接：请停止重连循环并采用退避策略

meaning.en: The connection does not support streaming (an intermediate proxy is buffering) — remove the buffering or fall back to webhooks
meaning.es: La conexión no soporta streaming (un proxy intermedio está bufferizando) — quita el buffering o usa webhooks
meaning.zh: 该连接不支持流式传输（中间代理在缓冲）— 关闭缓冲或改用 Webhook

meaning.en: The stream could not be opened; retry with backoff and keep your `Last-Event-ID`
meaning.es: No se pudo abrir el stream; reintenta con backoff conservando tu `Last-Event-ID`
meaning.zh: 无法打开事件流；请携带 `Last-Event-ID` 退避重试

category.es: Firma de mensajes y vinculación de wallets

meaning.en: The `chain` must be `tron` or `eth`
meaning.es: La `chain` debe ser `tron` o `eth`
meaning.zh: `chain` 必须是 `tron` 或 `eth`

category.es: Firma de mensajes y vinculación de wallets

meaning.en: The `statement` exceeds 280 characters — shorten it (note: the signed envelope itself accepts at most 140)
meaning.es: El `statement` supera los 280 caracteres — acórtalo (ojo: el sobre firmado acepta máximo 140)
meaning.zh: `statement` 超过 280 个字符 — 请缩短（注意：签名信封本身最多接受 140 个字符）

category.es: Firma de mensajes y vinculación de wallets

meaning.en: The proof is no longer in a signable state (already signed, expired or canceled) — request a new one
meaning.es: El comprobante ya no está en un estado firmable (ya firmado, expirado o cancelado) — solicita uno nuevo
meaning.zh: 该证明已不再处于可签名状态（已签名、已过期或已取消）— 请重新申请

category.es: Firma de mensajes y vinculación de wallets

meaning.en: The wallet's custody was transferred to the client, so server-side signing is no longer possible — sign with your own key
meaning.es: La custodia de la wallet fue transferida al cliente, así que la firma server-side ya no es posible — firma con tu propia clave
meaning.zh: 钱包托管权已转移给客户，无法再使用服务端签名 — 请用您自己的私钥签名

category.es: Firma de mensajes y vinculación de wallets

meaning.en: This challenge was already used or is no longer valid — request a new one
meaning.es: Este desafío ya fue usado o ya no es válido — solicita uno nuevo
meaning.zh: 该挑战已被使用或已失效 — 请重新申请

category.es: Firma de mensajes y vinculación de wallets

meaning.en: This challenge expired — request a new one and sign it within its validity window
meaning.es: Este desafío expiró — solicita uno nuevo y fírmalo dentro de su ventana de validez
meaning.zh: 该挑战已过期 — 请重新申请并在有效期内完成签名

category.es: Firma de mensajes y vinculación de wallets

meaning.en: The signature does not match the challenge address — sign the exact challenge message with the wallet you are linking
meaning.es: La firma no corresponde a la dirección del desafío — firma el mensaje exacto del desafío con la wallet que estás vinculando
meaning.zh: 签名与挑战地址不匹配 — 请用要绑定的钱包对挑战原文进行签名

category.es: Firma de mensajes y vinculación de wallets

meaning.en: The signer rejected the request — the `message` carries the scrubbed reason. A `statement` of 141–280 characters also lands here (the envelope accepts at most 140)
meaning.es: El firmante rechazó la solicitud — el `message` trae la razón saneada. Un `statement` de 141–280 caracteres también cae aquí (el sobre acepta máximo 140)
meaning.zh: 签名方拒绝了该请求 — `message` 中包含已脱敏的原因。141–280 个字符的 `statement` 也会在此处被拒绝（信封最多接受 140 个字符）

meaning.en: Unexpected error; retry with the same idempotency key
meaning.es: Error inesperado; reintenta con la misma clave de idempotencia
meaning.zh: 意外错误；请使用相同的幂等键重试

meaning.en: The account's fee configuration is invalid; contact support (the operation did not run)
meaning.es: La configuración de comisiones de la cuenta es inválida; contacta al soporte (la operación no se ejecutó)
meaning.zh: 账户的费用配置无效；请联系支持（该操作未执行）

meaning.en: FX rates temporarily unavailable
meaning.es: Tasas FX temporalmente no disponibles
meaning.zh: 汇率暂时不可用

meaning.en: Processor temporarily unavailable
meaning.es: Procesador temporalmente no disponible
meaning.zh: 处理方暂时不可用

meaning.en: The processor returned an unexpected response; retry with the **same** idempotency key
meaning.es: El procesador devolvió una respuesta inesperada; reintenta con la **misma** clave de idempotencia
meaning.zh: 处理方返回了意外响应；请使用**相同的**幂等键重试

meaning.en: AML screening temporarily unavailable
meaning.es: Screening AML temporalmente no disponible
meaning.zh: AML 筛查暂时不可用

meaning.en: Identity verification temporarily unavailable
meaning.es: Verificación de identidad temporalmente no disponible
meaning.zh: 身份验证暂时不可用

meaning.en: Service being configured; contact CBPay support
meaning.es: Servicio en configuración; contacta al soporte de CBPay
meaning.zh: 服务正在配置中；请联系 CBPay 支持

meaning.en: On-chain withdrawals not enabled for the corridor
meaning.es: Retiros on-chain no habilitados para el corredor
meaning.zh: 该通道未启用链上提现

meaning.en: BTC/GOLD execution price unavailable or stale; retry later or settle in USDT/USDC
meaning.es: Precio de ejecución de BTC/GOLD no disponible o desactualizado; reintenta más tarde o liquida en USDT/USDC
meaning.zh: BTC/GOLD 执行价格不可用或已过时；请稍后重试或以 USDT/USDC 结算

meaning.en: The payout channel is temporarily unavailable; retry later with the **same** idempotency key
meaning.es: El canal de payout está temporalmente no disponible; reintenta más tarde con la **misma** clave de idempotencia
meaning.zh: 出金通道暂时不可用；请稍后使用**相同的**幂等键重试

meaning.en: An inbound webhook event is already being processed; retry the same delivery after a short backoff and do not create a new operation
meaning.es: Un evento webhook entrante ya está siendo procesado; reintenta la misma entrega después de un backoff corto y no crees una operación nueva
meaning.zh: 入站 webhook 事件正在处理中；短暂退避后重试同一条投递，不要创建新的操作

meaning.en: Segregated wallet private key export is not enabled on this environment
meaning.es: El export de llaves privadas de wallets segregadas no está habilitado en este entorno
meaning.zh: 当前环境未启用独立钱包私钥导出

meaning.en: The Index period is not `YYYY-Q1` through `YYYY-Q4` — use a closed-quarter value
meaning.es: El período del Index no es `YYYY-Q1` a `YYYY-Q4` — usa un trimestre cerrado
meaning.zh: Index 时期不是 `YYYY-Q1` 到 `YYYY-Q4`；请使用已关闭季度

meaning.en: Fraud report generation failed after the charge path — the fee is refunded; retry with a new idempotency key
meaning.es: Falló la generación después del cargo — el fee se reembolsa; usa una nueva idempotency key
meaning.zh: 费用路径之后生成失败；费用已退回，使用新的幂等键重试

meaning.en: The selected corridor is administratively disabled. Use another enabled method or contact the organization operator.
meaning.es: El corredor seleccionado está deshabilitado administrativamente. Usa otro método habilitado o contacta al operador de la organización.
meaning.zh: 所选走廊被管理员禁用。请选择其他启用的 method 或联系组织运营人员。

meaning.en: 400 — Fix: Header/body keys differ or the same key is reused with a different request hash. Correct the request or use a new key.
meaning.es: 400 — Fix: Header/body keys differ or the same key is reused with a different request hash. Correct the request or use a new key.

meaning.en: 409 — Fix: The claim is terminally failed. Start a new operation with a new key after reviewing the failure.
meaning.es: 409 — Fix: The claim is terminally failed. Start a new operation with a new key after reviewing the failure.

meaning.en: 409 — Fix: The requested human recovery is no longer pending. Read the claim and use the terminal result.
meaning.es: 409 — Fix: The requested human recovery is no longer pending. Read the claim and use the terminal result.
meaning.zh: 409 — Fix: claim 已不再处于待处理状态。读取最终结果，不要重复恢复。

meaning.en: 409 — Fix: The provider customer is already linked to another account. Stop and investigate ownership.
meaning.es: 409 — Fix: The provider customer is already linked to another account. Stop and investigate ownership.
meaning.zh: 409 — Fix: 提供商客户已归属于其他账户。停止并检查所有权。

meaning.en: 409 — Fix: A lock is held by another banking operation. Retry the read/recovery flow later.
meaning.es: 409 — Fix: A lock is held by another banking operation. Retry the read/recovery flow later.

meaning.en: 422 — Fix: Provider account ownership did not match the claimed customer's `ProviderID`.
meaning.es: 422 — Fix: Provider account ownership did not match the claimed customer's `ProviderID`.

meaning.en: 422 — Fix: The provider customer identity does not match the original banking request. Stop recovery and review the claim.
meaning.es: 422 — Fix: La identidad del cliente del proveedor no coincide con la solicitud banking original. Detén la recuperación y revisa el claim.
meaning.zh: 422 — Fix: 提供商客户身份与原始 banking 请求不匹配。停止恢复并检查 claim。
